parent_protocol.fit: baseline training only: median over auto-spectral cells of mean(numerator at M=1) / repeat-record variance
parent_protocol.primary_family: auto: exact auto-spectral variance form; real/imaginary cross approximations are validated separately
parent_protocol.interpretation: calibrate the implemented estimated-auto-spectrum numerator; fitted M is not a literal Welch-segment count
parent_protocol.diagnostics: separate auto, real-cross, imaginary-cross and all-entry required M; no frequency-dependent M fitted
parent_protocol.validation: fresh held-out baseline, long-period and weak-wave records; fixed training M; no inverse or wave-truth scoring
parent_protocol.adoption: do not apply an auto-calibrated value globally if the cross-spectral variance approximation is incompatible
parent_protocol.scope: preserve existing forward/inverse assumptions; no independent-model overhaul in this study

parent.decision: fixed baseline-auto training M; no test fitting, inverse, or wave-truth inputs
parent.primary: median absolute log variance-ratio error across full-band cross entries; report signed bias and per-family results too
parent.tolerance: +/-10 percent for pooled median variance ratios; exploratory pointwise intervals are not simultaneous
parent.candidate: auto = a^2/M; cross Re/Im = [(M-1)/(2*(M-2))*(a*b-|z|^2) + Re(z)^2 or Im(z)^2]/M
parent.interpretation: M remains the fitted implemented auto denominator; complex-Wishart effective averages L=M-1; no extra fitted parameter

parent.additional: directional NRMSE, negative power, pointwise spectrum/direction/active-bin coverage, 95th percentile and worst errors, numerical checks
parent.truth: ensemble wave energy histogrammed into retained Welch cells; directions grouped to nearest inverse heading; full-sea Hs reported separately
parent.scoring: identical fresh spectra across methods; 1000 paired whole-record bootstrap draws for error differences; exact binomial intervals for scalar 95% coverage
parent.decision: no retuning; report improvement only with paired evidence; distinguish parameter recovery from conditional uncertainty; no production adoption by this script
parent.physics: same existing shared BEM/generator assumptions as main; linear inverse versus native nonlinear time simulation; no independent-physics validation

correlation: full Wishart Hermitian-basis factor from each measured sensor correlation matrix; row-normalised to retain fixed-M variances
stabilisation: shrink sensor correlation toward identity with clipped estimated complex-Wishart offdiagonal risk / measured squared offdiagonal norm; no inverse tuning
frequency: exact white/local-flat Hann overlap power correlation, aligned through Hermitian spectral-square-root factors; approximate for varying coloured spectra
calibration: only baseline sensor records 207000--207199 set units for fixed sensor-level probes; covariance estimator itself uses each record, M and Welch settings only
comparison: diagonal versus correlated entries only versus jointly correlated entries/frequencies; prior scales identical across methods
validation: 20 fixed sensor-only projections first, then band Hs, spectrum/direction errors, negative power, exact binomial coverage; 1000 paired record bootstrap draws
decision: no retuning after validation; no production, report or Drive writes; no proof of physical independence from fresh seeds
